requirements.label: Exact hero headline
requirements.sourcePoint: The source contains the exact visible H1 Move work forward without another meeting.
requirements.behaviorPoint: Chrome exposes the exact text as the page H1.

requirements.label: Cursor-grounded CTA hierarchy
requirements.sourcePoint: Only See how it works has the primary class and Start free has the secondary class.
requirements.behaviorPoint: See how it works is visibly filled while Start free is visibly outlined.

requirements.label: Cursor-grounded responsive navigation
requirements.sourcePoint: A 640px media query hides only the Resources navigation link.
requirements.behaviorPoint: Resources is visible at desktop and hidden at 390px while Product, Customers, and Pricing remain visible.

requirements.label: Motion-grounded assurance order
requirements.sourcePoint: Cancel anytime immediately precedes No credit card and all three assurances remain.
requirements.behaviorPoint: The DOM and rendered order match the requested source-to-destination motion.

requirements.label: Fully spoken mobile overflow repair
requirements.sourcePoint: The mobile proof grid is constrained to one container-width column without deleting cards.
requirements.behaviorPoint: At 390x844 document.scrollWidth is no greater than document.clientWidth and all three proof cards remain.

requirements.label: Cursor/state-grounded CTA interaction
requirements.sourcePoint: See how it works declares white hover/focus text and a nontransparent >=2px outline.
requirements.behaviorPoint: Hover/focus text contrast is >=4.5:1 and keyboard focus has >=3:1 indicator contrast.

regressionGates: No existing section, proof card, assurance, or navigation label outside the requested responsive state is removed.
No new external URL, product claim, CTA, or dependency is added.
Only index.html, styles.css, or app.js may be modified.
unsupportedAssumptions: removal of existing content outside the six targets
